elo_diff.description: Home minus away pre-game Elo rating
elo_diff.definition: elo_home_entering - elo_away_entering; Elo update r += K*(actual - expected), expected = 1/(1+10**((r_opp + HOME_ADV - r_self)/400)); actual = 1 win / 0 loss / 0.5 tie; 1/3 revert toward ELO_PRIOR at each season boundary
elo_diff.source: official NHL API scores (all decided games, 2024+)
elo_diff.point_in_time_rule: rating entering puck drop; updated only AFTER a game settles
elo_diff.missing_value_policy: ELO_PRIOR (1500) for a team's first-ever game; never NaN

win_pct_diff.description: Home minus away trailing win percentage
win_pct_diff.definition: mean(team_win) over the team's prior 12 games (no ties in the shootout era; OT/SO decided games award the W)
win_pct_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team rolling(12).mean().shift(1) — current and future games excluded
win_pct_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games; in-model handling

rest_days_diff.description: Home minus away days since each team's previous game
rest_days_diff.point_in_time_rule: days since the team's own strictly-prior game
rest_days_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN for a team's first game of the window; in-model handling

ewm_net_goals_diff.description: Home minus away exponentially-weighted net goals per game
ewm_net_goals_diff.definition: ewm(halflife=3).mean() of the team's net goals (for - against) over strictly-prior games
ewm_net_goals_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team ewm over prior games then shift(1)
ewm_net_goals_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games

ewm_goal_share_diff.description: Home minus away exponentially-weighted goal share
ewm_goal_share_diff.definition: ewm(halflife=3).mean() of goals_for / (goals_for + goals_against) over strictly-prior games — possession-neutral scoring strength in [0, 1]
ewm_goal_share_diff.aggregation: per-team EWM of the per-game goal share
ewm_goal_share_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team ewm over prior games then shift(1)
ewm_goal_share_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games

ga_per_game_diff.description: Home minus away trailing goals allowed per game
ga_per_game_diff.definition: rolling(5).mean() of goals against over strictly-prior games (lower = stingier defense; the diff is home − away)
ga_per_game_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games

shots_for_per_game_diff.description: Home minus away trailing shots on goal per game
shots_for_per_game_diff.definition: rolling(5).mean() of team shots on goal over strictly-prior games
shots_for_per_game_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games with SOG recorded

shots_against_per_game_diff.description: Home minus away trailing shots against per game
shots_against_per_game_diff.definition: rolling(5).mean() of opponent shots on goal over strictly-prior games (lower = better defensive structure)
shots_against_per_game_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games with SOG recorded

pp_success_diff.description: Home minus away trailing power-play success rate
pp_success_diff.definition: rolling(5).mean() of power-play goals / power-play opportunities over strictly-prior games
pp_success_diff.aggregation: trailing windowed mean of a per-game rate
pp_success_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games; a game with zero PP opportunities is excluded from that game's rate

faceoff_win_diff.description: Home minus away trailing faceoff win rate
faceoff_win_diff.definition: rolling(5).mean() of faceoffWinningPctg over strictly-prior games
faceoff_win_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games with faceoff data

back_to_back_diff.description: Home minus away back-to-back flag (rest < 1 day)
back_to_back_diff.definition: 1.0 when the team played the previous calendar day else 0.0; home flag minus away flag
back_to_back_diff.point_in_time_rule: function of the team's strictly-prior game date
back_to_back_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when either team has no prior game

goalie_sv_pct_diff.description: Home minus away expected-starter rolling save percentage
goalie_sv_pct_diff.definition: season-to-date (rolling-30-start EWM) save percentage of each team's expected starting goalie; home − away. The NHL analog of MLB's SP ERA diff
goalie_sv_pct_diff.source: official NHL API boxscores (goalie TOI + decision + shots faced)
goalie_sv_pct_diff.lookback: decaying (halflife=3 starts) over the season's starts
goalie_sv_pct_diff.aggregation: per-goalie EWM of the per-start save fraction
goalie_sv_pct_diff.point_in_time_rule: each goalie's strictly-prior starts only; the expected starter is the team's most-recent-game goalie with the most season starts
goalie_sv_pct_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no goalie with a prior start this season (e.g. opening-night unknown starter); never fabricated

goalie_gaa_diff.description: Home minus away expected-starter rolling goals-against average
goalie_gaa_diff.definition: season-to-date (rolling-30-start EWM) GAA of each team's expected starting goalie; home − away. The NHL analog of MLB's SP K/9 diff
goalie_gaa_diff.source: official NHL API boxscores (goalie goals against + TOI)
goalie_gaa_diff.lookback: decaying (halflife=3 starts) over the season's starts
goalie_gaa_diff.aggregation: per-goalie EWM of the per-start goals-against rate (per 60 min)
goalie_gaa_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when no goalie has a prior start; never fabricated

goalie_starts_diff.description: Home minus away expected-starter season starts
goalie_starts_diff.definition: season-to-date starts of each team's expected starting goalie — a workload/experience proxy for the SV%/GAA pair
goalie_starts_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when no goalie has a prior start

is_playoffs.definition: 1.0 when the game's gameType is 3 (playoffs) else 0.0
is_playoffs.missing_value_policy: 0.0 when gameType is absent (defaults to regular season)

is_home.definition: 1.0 for every row — anchors the league home-ice advantage level
